TelegramBot.help:
Mikka Telegram commands:
/new <title> — start a task draft
While a draft is open, send details, then /confirm to create it in Backlog
Send other messages to the Orchestrator; replies return here
/cancel — discard the draft
/issues — list recent tasks
/link ORV-123 or /link <issue UUID> — link this chat to a task
/status — show the linked task
/unlink — clear the link
TelegramBot.connect: Connect Telegram from Mikka Settings → Integrations, then open the link here.
TelegramBot.alreadyConnected: Your Telegram account is already connected. Send /help for commands.
TelegramBot.paired: Telegram is connected to Mikka. Send /help to see commands.
TelegramBot.pairInvalid: That link has expired or was already used. Generate a fresh one in Mikka Settings → Integrations.
TelegramBot.pairConflict: This Telegram account is already connected to another Mikka account.
TelegramBot.titleRequired: Use /new followed by a title up to 200 characters.
TelegramBot.draftStarted:
Draft started: {title}
Send one or more detail messages, then /confirm. Use /cancel to discard.
TelegramBot.noDraft: There is no draft to discard.
TelegramBot.draftInvalid: The draft is invalid. Use /new <title> to start again.
TelegramBot.created:
Created {issue} in Backlog: {title}
Use /status to view it.
TelegramBot.finishDraft: Finish or discard the current draft before linking a task.
TelegramBot.taskUnavailable: That task was not found or is not available to this account.
TelegramBot.ambiguous: That task number is ambiguous. Use its full issue UUID.
TelegramBot.notLinked: This chat is not linked to a task. Use /link ORV-123.
TelegramBot.linkedUnavailable: The linked task is no longer available.
TelegramBot.unlinkNoTask: This chat is not linked to a task.
TelegramBot.unknownCommand: I did not recognize that command. Send /help for the list.
TelegramBot.textDetailsRequired: Send text details, or use /confirm to create without a description.
TelegramBot.draftTooLong: The draft has reached its 20,000 character limit. Use /confirm or /cancel.
TelegramBot.detailsAdded: Details added. Send more, or use /confirm to create the Backlog task.
TelegramBot.linkedChat: This chat is linked to a task. Use /status, /unlink, or /new <title>.
